Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Craig Jones' earlier leg lock defence series from Grapplers Guide (Lachlan Giles' platform): 23 short lessons, about 90 minutes in total. It works through the main entanglements one at a time. It starts with foot position (heel hook versus ankle lock defence, 'ballerina toes'), then inside ashi and double outside ashi in stages (including the 'Khabib grip' counters to a back take or arm triangle), then standing escapes that spin the opponent, inside heel hook defence (including a berimbolo-style escape), the saddle / 4-11, and preventing the inside heel hook from reverse De La Riva and X guard. Marked 'outdated' in your collection because Get Off My Legs Gringo replaced it, but the individual lessons are short and clear.
Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi players who want to look up one specific leg lock defence quickly.
key: Foot position for heel hook defence
Inside ashi and double outside ashi escapes
Counter-attacks: back take and arm triangle
Inside heel hook and saddle defence
Stopping heel hooks from RDLR and X guard
sources: Grapplers Guide course; based on the lesson titles.

Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Twelve short YouTube lessons (about 50 minutes) from early in Craig Jones' career on his floating Z-half guard, a knee shield half guard where the bottom leg isn't hooked. It covers getting it with a leg underhook and staying safe, position tips, and leg attacks off it: basic, outside and inside heel hooks, exposing the heel when they plant their foot, rolling back to the saddle / 4-11, going to reverse X, and kneebars when the opponent jumps over or sprawls (several finishes credited to Quintet matches and Jake Shields).
Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: Z-guard players who want leg lock entries from it.
key: Saddle via back roll or reverse X
Kneebar counters to jump-overs and sprawls
sources: YouTube lessons; based on the titles.

Daisy Fresh.overview: Heath Pedigo's Daisy Fresh curriculum as 96 short, individually named lessons in four parts, apparently from his own online curriculum and different from the white belt stripe DVDs. Part I is passing (pressure passes, knee pressure, folding, split passes and half guard passing including the 'Sao Pedigo', back takes and the 'Bernardo killer'). Part II is closed guard (jump guard, cross collar, punch choke, armbar, triangle and bump sweeps, flower sweep) and half guard (flat half, knee shield, the knee shield roll). Part III is passing open and seated guards (stomp, chain and split passes, double under, skirt drag, front headlock, knee cut, sleeve pins). Part IV is open guard (spider guard and its retention, overhead and deadlift sweeps, triangle, omoplata, shin sweeps, wrestle-ups, ankle lock, short and long hook sweeps, berimbolo and back takes).
Daisy Fresh.for: Anyone wanting bite-sized fundamentals; good for looking up one technique.
key: Spider guard, shin and hook sweeps
